review_candidates.title: Senior Network Security Engineer
review_candidates.company: Virtual Tech Gurus India Pvt Ltd
review_candidates.description: We are looking for a highly experienced L3/L4 Network & Security Engineer with strong hands-on experience in Routing, Switching, Enterprise Firewalls, Network Implementation, Troubleshooting and Migration Projects . The candidate must be able to independently handle end-to-end network and firewall activities , including configuration, implementation, troubleshooting, upgrades, replacement and migration. Key responsibilities Palo Alto: Primary firewall technology and mandatory hands-on expertise. Cisco Firepower/FTD, Sophos and FortiGate are secondary firewall technologies. Palo Alto Panorama: Administration, configuration, centralized policy management, monitoring, troubleshooting and validation. Routers : Configuration, troubleshooting, upgrades, replacement and migration. Switches : Access, Distribution, Core and Data Center switching; configuration, troubleshooting, upgrades, replacement and migration. Routing : BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, Static Routing, PBR, VRF, route redistribution and route filtering. Switching : VLAN, trunking, STP/RSTP/MSTP, LACP/EtherChannel, HSRP/VRRP and VPC/MLAG. Firewall Configuration : Security policies, NAT, routing, VPN, HA, security profiles, objects, zones and logging. Firewall Migration : End-to-end migration from one firewall vendor/platform to another, including discovery, assessment, policy conversion/mapping, object migration, NAT, routing, VPN, testing, cutover, rollback and post-migration troubleshooting. Multi-Site Firewall Migration : Experience supporting or leading multi-site firewall migration and deployment activities, including site-wise planning, cutover, validation, rollback and post-cutover stabilization. Network Migration : Core, Distribution, WAN, Internet Edge and Data Center migrations, including IP, VLAN and routing migrations. Implementation : Greenfield and existing-environment deployments, including end-to-end implementation, testing and validation. Troubleshooting : Device-level, protocol-level, packet-level and end-to-end application connectivity troubleshooting across network and firewall infrastructure. Major Incidents : P1/P2 incident troubleshooting, resolution, escalation management and Root Cause Analysis (RCA). Network & Firewall Optimization : Network performance, routing, firewall rules, HA, capacity and architecture optimization. SOW & Technical Validation : Ability to technically review and validate the SOW, proposed solution, HLD/LLD, implementation approach, dependencies, risks and technical requirements. Design Review : Review network and firewall designs and provide technical recommendations before implementation or migration. Migration Planning & Cutover : Develop and review migration plans, MOPs, test plans and rollback procedures; support planned production cutovers, including night/weekend maintenance windows when required. Post-Migration Stabilization : Perform post-cutover validation, troubleshooting, issue resolution and stabilization of the network and firewall environment. Customer-Facing Activities : Work directly with customers, technical stakeholders and project teams for requirements, design discussions, technical reviews, migration planning, implementation and issue resolution. Knowledge Transfer : Conduct knowledge-transfer sessions and provide technical handover

Direct the daily work allocation between the onsite and offsite engineers and act as their technical escalation point. Quality-assure change records, re-scan evidence, and the weekly/monthly reporting pack before client submission. ITIL change management and CAB processes; SLA/KPI governance and reporting to enterprise/government stakeholders. Leadership and ownership mindset; comfortable owning KPIs and audits for a government client; strong mentor. review_candidates.title: IT Systems Engineer L1
review_candidates.description: About the Job As an IT Systems Engineer - Hybrid at Nexus Tech Support , you will be dedicated to supporting one of our premier clients—a leading Big 5 insurance enterprise in the United States . In this role, you will act as a key technical contact, diagnosing, troubleshooting, and resolving software-related issues for our client and their end-users. You will ensure seamless operations by providing high-quality software support, system troubleshooting, and technical assistance, helping users maintain maximum productivity while working across modern hybrid environments. Key Responsibilities ● Remote Support & Incident Resolution: Deliver remote technical support via enterprise ticketing systems, email, and remote management tools for client end-users encountering software, operational, and configuration challenges. ● Diagnostic Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve complex software anomalies, application crashes, profile corruptions, and operating system errors across virtual and hybrid user environments. ● Access Management: Handle user access, group memberships, and permission requests within Active Directory, ensuring strict adherence to security and compliance protocols. ● Virtual Session Availability: Support remote workspace availability, assisting users with virtual desktop connections, session management, and related client software. ● Application Deployment: Deploy, update, and configure business-critical software applications, ensuring software patches and scheduled updates are applied smoothly. ● Incident Documentation: Log, track, and document incident lifecycles with thorough technical notes, diagnostic steps, and verified resolution procedures within the service management platform. ● Tiered Escalation: Identify recurring incidents and systemic infrastructure anomalies, escalating complex problems to senior engineering tiers accompanied by preliminary diagnostic logs. End-User Guidance: Guide and educate end-users on software best practices and client-specific business tools to minimize downtime and prevent repeat tickets. Requirements & Qualifications ● Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience), with 1–2 years of hands-on experience in technical support, help desk, or IT operations. ● Operating Systems & Infrastructure: Solid understanding of client and server operating systems (Windows 10/11 and Windows Server fundamentals). ● Identity & Access Management: Solid foundational understanding of Active Directory core concepts, including user provisioning, security groups, and permissions, alongside basic administration of Microsoft 365 (M365) and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA). ● Virtualization Fundamentals: Good foundational knowledge of virtualization technologies, with preferred familiarity or hands-on exposure to VMware environments. ● Scripting & Automation Basics: Familiarity with command-line tools (CMD) and basic PowerShell scripting for routine administrative tasks and troubleshooting. ● Support Tools & Ticketing: Experience utilizing remote support/desktop tools and standard enterprise ticketing systems to manage incident lifecycles. ● Certifications (Preferred): Relevant IT certifications such as CompTIA (A+, Network+), CCNA, or Microsoft role-based fundamentals/administrator credentials are an advantage. ● Language & Communication: Strong verbal and written English communication skills ( B2 level or higher ), with a client-first mindset and the ability to communicate fluently and effectively with US-based users and stakeholders. ● Work Schedule & Availability: Ability and willingness to work full-time hours aligned with the US Eastern Standard Time ( EST ) zone. Core Competencies: Detail-oriented problem solver, quick learner, and highly motivated to expand technical skills into enterprise systems engineering.

through thoughtful access-point placement, configuration, and troubleshooting Operate and tune network and endpoint security controls, including firewalls, IDS/IPS, and EDR/XDR, and support the containment of network- or endpoint-related threats Manage network access and device onboarding using technologies such as RADIUS, 802.1X, mesh VPN access controls, and device certificates where Share knowledge with the wider IT team and help establish consistent, secure practices for everyday support and network changes What You Could Bring Hands-on experience operating wired and wireless networks across multiple office locations Solid networking fundamentals across routing, switching, VLANs, firewall policies, VPNs, and Wi-Fi Practical experience implementing network segmentation and access-control solutions such as RADIUS, 802.1X, or comparable technologies Experience with network platforms such as Fortinet, Juniper, or Mist, or closely comparable technologies The ability to plan, optimize, and troubleshoot wireless networks, including access-point placement, coverage, roaming, and configuration Strong troubleshooting skills across Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking, Wi-Fi, firewall policies, and VPN connectivity Experience owning business-critical network infrastructure independently or acting as the lead network specialist in a growing organization A security-minded approach grounded in least privilege, secure defaults, clear standards, and risk reduction A thoughtful approach to production-impacting changes, including testing, backout planning, documentation, and stakeholder communication The ability to take ownership of ambiguous technical problems, make sound decisions, and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical colleagues Experience with mesh networking, certificate-based device identity, cloud networking, infrastructure as code, SIEM, or network monitoring and detection tooling is a plus Our Copenhagen office mirrors our innovative technology – with an indoor ball court, rooftop terrace, and well-equipped gym. Values we hold at Veo: Dare - We take initiative, stay curious, and challenge the status quo in our work. Play as a team - We collaborate across a diverse organization, leveraging shared insights for stronger outcomes. Customer Centric - We deliver value by having close partnerships and a deep understanding of our customers (internally and externally) We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, even if your experience doesn’t completely match every qualification listed.
